  "title": "Supply and Demand Planning Manager",
  "description": "Emzor Pharmaceutical Industries is one of Nigeria&#39;s leading&nbsp;&nbsp;pharmaceutical companies, dedicated to providing premium, affordable medical treatments. We have been manufacturing pharmaceutical and health products for over 40 years. We are promoting unlimited wellness by offering innovative, long-lasting medical solutions.&nbsp;

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Supply and Demand Planning Manager
Job Location: Lagos Mainland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary


	The Supply and Demand Planning Manager is responsible for ensuring the efficient and uninterrupted flow of materials to support production schedules while maintaining optimal inventory levels across the organization.
	The role leads Sales &amp; Operations Planning (S&amp;OP) engagements across all plants and oversees demand planning, supply planning, production planning, and inventory management for Raw Materials (RM), Packaging Materials (PM), and Finished Goods (FG).


Key Responsibilities
Demand, Supply &amp; Production Planning:


	Lead monthly demand review and S&amp;OP meetings while managing the demand forecasting and supply planning process to align customer demand, production capacity, and inventory targets.
	Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts, production plans, and replenishment schedules using historical data, market intelligence, and validated demand drivers.
	Translate approved demand forecasts and inventory strategies into executable supply plans for internal manufacturing sites and third-party manufacturers.


Inventory Management &amp; Optimization:


	Monitor and control RM, PM, and FG inventory levels in line with safety stock targets to minimize stock-outs, expiries, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory.
	Provide visibility on inventory risks and opportunities, including support for new product launches, phase-outs, and constrained items.
	Ensure inventory and data accuracy by validating AWC, BOM integrity, master data, and supporting periodic stock counts and reconciliations.


Material Planning &amp; Order Management:&nbsp;

StrategicPlanning


	Plan and schedule material supply to meet approved production plans while managing daily order planning and delivery performance.
	Proactively monitor material availability, follow up on shortages, and implement mitigation actions to protect production schedules.
	Collaborate with Direct Procurement to optimize inbound material flow and align volume requirements with planning assumptions.


Risk Management, Systems &amp; Continuous Improvement:


	Identify, assess, and communicate supply chain risks, constraints, and mitigation plans while ensuring clear documentation and escalation where required.
	Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Production, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Projects, Customer Service, and Provider Engagement teams to align plans and execution.
	Drive continuous improvement by optimizing ERP/MRP usage, maintaining data integrity, and enhancing demand review, supply review, and Sales and Operations Planning S&amp;OP processes.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&rsquo;s or Master&rsquo;s Degree in Business Administration, Economics and Statistics
	Professional certification preferred: CIPS and CIPM
	An advanced degree (MBA, MSc in Supply Chain Management) is desirable.
	Minimum of 5-10years&#39; experience in production planning
	Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written as well as excellent communication and presentation.
	Experience in Pharmaceuticals or FMCG will be an added advantage


Key Competencies:


	Exceptional leadership and influencing skills; able to drive accountability across teams and functions.
	Deep understanding of production life cycle
	Passion for transformation and continuous improvement.
	Strategic thinker with operational discipline and hands-on problem-solving ability.
	High-level cross-functional engagement skills and stakeholder management
	Exposure to product development or technology transfer projects in a regulated (GMP) environment.
	Self-driven, outcome-driven, and taking initiative to drive the process.


What we Offer


	Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
	A supportive and dynamic work environment with clear career growth opportunities.
	Comprehensive medical insurance, pension, and other employee benefits.

Supply and Demand Planning Manager Job at Emzor Pharmaceutical Industries Limited




        
    

        
        Emzor Pharmaceutical Industries is one of Nigeria's leading  pharmaceutical companies, dedicated to providing premium, affordable medical treatments. We have been manufacturing pharmaceutical and health products for over 40 years. We are promoting unlimited wellness by offering innovative, long-lasting medical solutions. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Supply and Demand Planning Manager
Job Location: Lagos Mainland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Summary
     

            
    




	The Supply and Demand Planning Manager is responsible for ensuring the efficient and uninterrupted flow of materials to support production schedules while maintaining optimal inventory levels across the organization.
	The role leads Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) engagements across all plants and oversees demand planning, supply planning, production planning, and inventory management for Raw Materials (RM), Packaging Materials (PM), and Finished Goods (FG).


Key Responsibilities
Demand, Supply & Production Planning:


	Lead monthly demand review and S&OP meetings while managing the demand forecasting and supply planning process to align customer demand, production capacity, and inventory targets.
	Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts, production plans, and replenishment schedules using historical data, market intelligence, and validated demand drivers.
	Translate approved demand forecasts and inventory strategies into executable supply plans for internal manufacturing sites and third-party manufacturers.


Inventory Management & Optimization:


	Monitor and control RM, PM, and FG inventory levels in line with safety stock targets to minimize stock-outs, expiries, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory.
	Provide visibility on inventory risks and opportunities, including support for new product launches, phase-outs, and constrained items.
	Ensure inventory and data accuracy by validating AWC, BOM integrity, master data, and supporting periodic stock counts and reconciliations.


Material Planning & Order Management: 

StrategicPlanning


	Plan and schedule material supply to meet approved production plans while managing daily order planning and delivery performance.
	Proactively monitor material availability, follow up on shortages, and implement mitigation actions to protect production schedules.
	Collaborate with Direct Procurement to optimize inbound material flow and align volume requirements with planning assumptions.


Risk Management, Systems & Continuous Improvement:


	Identify, assess, and communicate supply chain risks, constraints, and mitigation plans while ensuring clear documentation and escalation where required.
	Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Production, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Projects, Customer Service, and Provider Engagement teams to align plans and execution.
	Drive continuous improvement by optimizing ERP/MRP usage, maintaining data integrity, and enhancing demand review, supply review, and Sales and Operations Planning S&OP processes.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Economics and Statistics
	Professional certification preferred: CIPS and CIPM
	An advanced degree (MBA, MSc in Supply Chain Management) is desirable.
	Minimum of 5-10years' experience in production planning
	Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written as well as excellent communication and presentation.
	Experience in Pharmaceuticals or FMCG will be an added advantage


Key Competencies:


	Exceptional leadership and influencing skills; able to drive accountability across teams and functions.
	Deep understanding of production life cycle
	Passion for transformation and continuous improvement.
	Strategic thinker with operational discipline and hands-on problem-solving ability.
	High-level cross-functional engagement skills and stakeholder management
	Exposure to product development or technology transfer projects in a regulated (GMP) environment.
	Self-driven, outcome-driven, and taking initiative to drive the process.


What we Offer


	Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
	A supportive and dynamic work environment with clear career growth opportunities.
	Comprehensive medical insurance, pension, and other employee benefits.

HSE Supervisor Job at Emzor Pharmaceutical Industries Limited




        
    

        
        Emzor Pharmaceutical Industries is one of Nigeria's leading pharmaceutical companies, dedicated to providing premium, affordable medical treatments. We have been manufacturing pharmaceutical and health products for over 40 years. We are promoting unlimited wellness by offering innovative, long-lasting medical solutions. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HSE Supervisor

Job Location: Lagos Mainland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work mode: Onsite

Summary of Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Carrying out a daily routine walk-around of factory/warehouse floors, waste areas, and the environment, as well as inspecting fire and emergency equipment to identify residual risks and ensure a safe workplace.
	Investigate Accidents, make recommendations for corrective actions, and send a report to the HSE Manager
	Review and analyze near-miss incidents and make recommendations
	Conducting daily monitoring/analysis of the Effluent Treatment Plant.
	Documenting, arranging, and filing of HSE documents in line with the ISO standard.
	Assisting with implementing safe work procedures and regularly inspecting job/production sites for hazard identification, reduction, and elimination using appropriate control measures.


Qualifications & Experience


	Minimum of a B.Sc./HND Degree in Sciences.
	1-3 years of experience on the job.
	HSE Level 3 Supervisory certification and NEBOSH are an added advantage


Key Competencies:


	Hazards and Risk Assessment
	Interpersonal skills and Communication skills.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary and performance bonus.
	A dynamic work environment that fosters career development and growth opportunities.
	Medical insurance and retirement benefits, etc.

Marketer / Sales Executive Job at Galaxy La-Palm Royal Resort




        
    

        
        Galaxy La-Palm Royal Resort - Our hotel is a prestigious 5-star hotel and resort dedicated to providing exceptional hospitality, comfort, luxury, and memorable experiences to our guests. Our commitment is to maintain the highest standards of excellence, cleanliness, safety, customer service, and professionalism, ensuring that every guest enjoys a comfortable and remarkable stay. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Marketer / Sales Executive

Employment Type: Full-time

	To drive the hotel’s revenue by promoting its rooms, restaurants, conference and event facilities, spa, and other services, while building strong relationships with existing and potential clients.

	Develop and implement effective sales and marketing strategies to increase hotel revenue and occupancy.
	Identify and acquire new corporate, individual, group, and event clients.
	Maintain strong relationships with existing clients and ensure repeat business.
	Promote hotel rooms, banqueting, conferences, restaurants, spa, and other facilities.
	Monitor competitors, market trends, and customer needs to identify new business opportunities.
	Promote the hotel through appropriate digital, social media, corporate, and traditional marketing channels.
	Meet assigned monthly sales targets and provide regular sales and marketing reports to management.


Requirements


	BSc Degree. in Marketing, Hospitality, Retail, Service Management, or a related field with 10-12 years of experience
	Excellent Communication Skill
	Customer Relationship Management
	Persuasion & Negoitiation Skills
	Target Oriented mindset
	Problem sloving skill
	Sales & Business Development Skills

Backend Engineer (APIs & Financial Infrastructure) Job at Oconsulting Limited




        
    

        
        Oconsulting Limited, an independed recruiter / HR consulting firm, is recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Backend Engineer (APIs & Financial Infrastructure)

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Hybrid

Job Description
     

            
    




	We're looking for a Backend Engineer with 4–5 years of experience to help us build the core infrastructure powering financial products at scale.
	This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll design and build APIs and backend systems where reliability, correctness, performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable.
	You'll work on hard problems across payments, financial data, distributed systems, third-party integrations, and developer infrastructure, and have significant ownership over the systems you build.


Responsibilities
What You'll Do:


	Design and build high-performance, production-grade APIs and backend services.
	Build reliable systems for financial transactions where correctness and data integrity are critical.
	Design for scale, failure, retries, idempotency, concurrency, and observability.
	Work with databases, queues, external APIs, and financial institution integrations.
	Own systems end-to-end: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
	Debug complex production issues and improve the reliability and performance of our infrastructure.
	Make and drive technical decisions that shape how Anchor's backend evolves.
	Work closely with other engineers and product teams to turn complex financial problems into simple, reliable systems.


Requirements


	3–5 years of strong backend engineering experience.
	Deep experience building production APIs and backend systems.
	Strong understanding of system design, databases, distributed systems, and software architecture.
	Experience designing reliable systems with considerations around concurrency, idempotency, retries, and failure handling.
	Strong API design and third-party integration experience.
	High standards for code quality, testing, observability, and maintainability.
	Comfortable owning problems from architecture → code → production.
	Strong technical judgment and a genuine interest in solving difficult engineering problems.


Bonus:


	Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other systems where correctness and reliability are critical.
